correctness.rationale: Direct enumeration of the three rooted forest edge subsets gives Z=q^3+2(a+b)q^2+3abq. Laplacian eigenvalues have sum 2(a+b), product 3ab; hence R_q=1+two independent Bernoullis and V=(1+v cosh t)/(v+cosh t)^2, with v=(a+b)/sqrt(3ab), t=log(q/sqrt(3ab)). Differentiating in u=cosh t>=1 yields (v^2-2-vu)/(v+u)^3. This proves the unique-mode vs double-mode threshold v=2, its ratio 5±2sqrt6, exact peaks, quartic flatness and one-/two-vertex minimality. Independently rederived 12 direct rational variance cases; finite tests do not substitute for derivative.
